verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν ἀδελφοί ὅτι ἡμῶν οἱ πατέρες ἦσαν πάντες ὑπὸ τὴν νεφέλην καὶ πάντες διῆλθον διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης
verses.transliteration: gar Ou thelō hymas agnoein adelphoi hoti hēmōn hoi pateres ēsan pantes hypo tēn nephelēn kai pantes diēlthon dia tēs thalassēs
verses.literal: - vvv I do not want you to be unaware brothers that our - forefathers were all under the cloud and [that] they all passed through the sea

verses.original: καὶ πάντες ἐβαπτίσαντο εἰς τὸν Μωϋσῆν ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ
verses.transliteration: kai pantes ebaptisanto eis ton Mōusēn en tē nephelē kai en tē thalassē
verses.literal: - vvv They were all baptized into - Moses in the cloud and in the sea

verses.original: καὶ πάντες ἔφαγον τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν βρῶμα
verses.transliteration: kai pantes ephagon to auto pneumatikon brōma
verses.literal: - They all ate the same spiritual food

verses.original: καὶ πάντες ἔπιον τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν πόμα γὰρ ἔπινον ἐκ πνευματικῆς πέτρας ἀκολουθούσης δὲ ἡ πέτρα ἦν ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: kai pantes epion to auto pneumatikon poma gar epinon ek pneumatikēs petras akolouthousēs de hē petra ēn ho Christos
verses.literal: and - drank the same spiritual drink for they drank from [the] spiritual rock that accompanied them and [that] rock was - Christ

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὁ Θεός οὐκ εὐδόκησεν ἐν τοῖς πλείοσιν αὐτῶν γὰρ κατεστρώθησαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: all’ ho Theos ouk eudokēsen en tois pleiosin autōn gar katestrōthēsan en tē erēmō
verses.literal: Nevertheless - God vvv was not pleased with - most of them for they were struck down in the wilderness

verses.original: δὲ Ταῦτα ἐγενήθησαν τύποι ἡμῶν εἰς ἡμᾶς μὴ τὸ εἶναι ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν καθὼς κἀκεῖνοι ἐπεθύμησαν
verses.transliteration: de Tauta egenēthēsan typoi hēmōn eis hēmas mē to einai epithymētas kakōn kathōs kakeinoi epethymēsan
verses.literal: - These things took place as examples - to keep us vvv vvv vvv from craving evil things as they [did]

verses.original: μηδὲ γίνεσθε εἰδωλολάτραι καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ὥσπερ γέγραπται ὁ λαὸς Ἐκάθισεν φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν
verses.transliteration: mēde ginesthe eidōlolatrai kathōs tines autōn hōsper gegraptai ho laos Ekathisen phagein kai pein kai anestēsan paizein
verses.literal: vvv Do not be idolaters as some of them [were] As it is written The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry

verses.original: μηδὲ πορνεύωμεν καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπόρνευσαν καὶ μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ εἰκοσι τρεῖς χιλιάδες ἔπεσαν
verses.transliteration: mēde porneuōmen kathōs tines autōn eporneusan kai mia hēmera eikosi treis chiliades epesan
verses.literal: vvv We should not commit sexual immorality as some of them [did] and in one day twenty-three . . . thousand [of them] died

verses.original: μηδὲ ἐκπειράζωμεν τὸν Χριστόν καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπείρασαν καὶ ἀπώλλυντο ὑπὸ τῶν ὄφεων
verses.transliteration: mēde ekpeirazōmen ton Christon kathōs tines autōn epeirasan kai apōllynto hypo tōn opheōn
verses.literal: - We should not test - Christ as some of them [did] and were killed by - snakes

verses.original: μηδὲ γογγύζετε καθάπερ τινὲς αὐτῶν ἐγόγγυσαν καὶ ἀπώλοντο ὑπὸ τοῦ ὀλοθρευτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mēde gongyzete kathaper tines autōn egongysan kai apōlonto hypo tou olothreutou
verses.literal: vvv And do not complain as some of them [did] and were killed by the destroying angel

verses.original: δὲ Ταῦτα συνέβαινεν ἐκείνοις τυπικῶς δὲ ἐγράφη νουθεσίαν πρὸς ἡμῶν εἰς οὓς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων κατήντηκεν
verses.transliteration: de Tauta synebainen ekeinois typikōs de egraphē nouthesian pros hēmōn eis hous ta telē tōn aiōnōn katēntēken
verses.literal: Now these things happened to them [as] examples and were written down as warnings for us on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come

verses.original: Ὥστε ὁ δοκῶν ἑστάναι βλεπέτω μὴ πέσῃ
verses.transliteration: Hōste ho dokōn hestanai blepetō mē pesē
verses.literal: So the [one who] thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall

verses.original: οὐκ πειρασμὸς εἴληφεν ὑμᾶς εἰ μὴ ἀνθρώπινος δὲ ὁ Θεός πιστὸς ὃς οὐκ ἐάσει ὑμᾶς πειρασθῆναι ὑπὲρ ὃ δύνασθε ἀλλὰ σὺν τῷ πειρασμῷ ποιήσει καὶ τὴν ἔκβασιν τοῦ δύνασθαι ὑπενεγκεῖν
verses.transliteration: ouk peirasmos eilēphen hymas ei mē anthrōpinos de ho Theos pistos hos ouk easei hymas peirasthēnai hyper ho dynasthe alla syn tō peirasmō poiēsei kai tēn ekbasin tou dynasthai hypenenkein
verses.literal: No temptation has seized you except . . . what is common to man And - God [is] faithful [He] vvv will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear But when - [you are] tempted He will also provide . . . - an escape - so that you can stand up under [it]

verses.original: Διόπερ μου ἀγαπητοί φεύγετε ἀπὸ τῆς εἰδωλολατρίας
verses.transliteration: Dioper mou agapētoi pheugete apo tēs eidōlolatrias
verses.literal: Therefore my beloved flee from - idolatry

verses.original: λέγω ὡς φρονίμοις κρίνατε ὑμεῖς ὅ φημι
verses.transliteration: legō hōs phronimois krinate hymeis ho phēmi
verses.literal: I speak . . . to reasonable [people] judge for yourselves what I say

verses.original: ἐστὶν οὐχὶ Τὸ ποτήριον τῆς εὐλογίας ὃ εὐλογοῦμεν κοινωνία τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐστιν οὐχὶ τὸν ἄρτον ὃν κλῶμεν κοινωνία τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: estin ouchi To potērion tēs eulogias ho eulogoumen koinōnia tou haimatos tou Christou estin ouchi ton arton hon klōmen koinōnia tou sōmatos tou Christou
verses.literal: Is not the cup - of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood - of Christ [And] is not the bread that we break a participation in the body - of Christ

verses.original: ὅτι εἷς ἄρτος οἱ πολλοί ἐσμεν ἓν σῶμα γὰρ οἱ πάντες μετέχομεν ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἄρτου
verses.transliteration: hoti heis artos hoi polloi esmen hen sōma gar hoi pantes metechomen ek tou henos artou
verses.literal: Because [there is] one loaf [we who are] many are one body for - vvv we all partake of the one loaf

verses.original: βλέπετε τὸν κατὰ σάρκα Ἰσραὴλ εἰσίν οὐχ οἱ ἐσθίοντες τὰς θυσίας κοινωνοὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου
verses.transliteration: blepete ton kata sarka Israēl eisin ouch hoi esthiontes tas thysias koinōnoi tou thysiastēriou
verses.literal: Consider - vvv the people of Israel Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar

verses.original: φημι οὖν Τί ὅτι εἰδωλόθυτόν ἐστιν τί ἢ ὅτι εἴδωλόν ἐστιν τί
verses.transliteration: phēmi oun Ti hoti eidōlothyton estin ti ē hoti eidōlon estin ti
verses.literal: Am I suggesting then - that food sacrificed to an idol is anything or that an idol is anything

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἃ θύουσιν τὰ ἔθνη θύουσιν δαιμονίοις καὶ οὐ Θεῷ δὲ οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς γίνεσθαι κοινωνοὺς τῶν δαιμονίων
verses.transliteration: all’ hoti ha thyousin ta ethnē thyousin daimoniois kai ou Theō de ou thelō hymas ginesthai koinōnous tōn daimoniōn
verses.literal: No [but] [the] sacrifices - of pagans are offered to demons - not to God And vvv I do not want you to be participants - with demons

verses.original: οὐ δύνασθε πίνειν ποτήριον Κυρίου καὶ ποτήριον δαιμονίων οὐ δύνασθε μετέχειν τραπέζης Κυρίου καὶ τραπέζης δαιμονίων
verses.transliteration: ou dynasthe pinein potērion Kyriou kai potērion daimoniōn ou dynasthe metechein trapezēs Kyriou kai trapezēs daimoniōn
verses.literal: vvv You cannot drink [the] cup of [the] Lord and [the] cup of demons [too] vvv you cannot partake in [the] table of [the] Lord and [the] table of demons {too}

verses.original: ἢ παραζηλοῦμεν τὸν Κύριον ἐσμεν μὴ ἰσχυρότεροι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ē parazēloumen ton Kyrion esmen mē ischyroteroi autou
verses.literal: - Are we trying to provoke the Lord {to jealousy} Are we . . . stronger than He

verses.original: Πάντα ἔξεστιν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει Πάντα ἔξεστιν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα οἰκοδομεῖ
verses.transliteration: Panta exestin all’ ou panta sympherei Panta exestin all’ ou panta oikodomei
verses.literal: Everything is permissible but not everything is beneficial Everything is permissible but not everything is edifying

verses.original: μηδεὶς ζητείτω ἑαυτοῦ τὸ ἀλλὰ τὸ τοῦ ἑτέρου
verses.transliteration: mēdeis zēteitō heautou to alla to tou heterou
verses.literal: No one should seek his own [good] but [the good] - of others

verses.original: ἐσθίετε Πᾶν τὸ πωλούμενον ἐν μακέλλῳ μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: esthiete Pan to pōloumenon en makellō mēden anakrinontes dia tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: Eat anything - sold in [the] meat market without raising questions of - conscience

verses.original: γὰρ Ἡ γῆ Τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: gar Hē gē Tou Kyriou kai to plērōma autēs
verses.literal: for The earth [is] the Lord’s and the fullness thereof

verses.original: Εἴ τις τῶν ἀπίστων καλεῖ ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλετε πορεύεσθαι ἐσθίετε πᾶν τὸ παρατιθέμενον ὑμῖν μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: Ei tis tōn apistōn kalei hymas kai thelete poreuesthai esthiete pan to paratithemenon hymin mēden anakrinontes dia tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: If an - unbeliever invites you {to a meal} and you want to go eat anything - set before you without raising questions of - conscience

verses.original: δέ ἐὰν τις εἴπῃ ὑμῖν Τοῦτο ἐστιν ἱερόθυτόν μὴ ἐσθίετε δι’ ἐκεῖνον τὸν μηνύσαντα καὶ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: de ean tis eipē hymin Touto estin hierothyton mē esthiete di’ ekeinon ton mēnysanta kai tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: But if someone tells you This [food] was offered to idols {then do} not eat [it] for the sake of the one who told [you] and - for the sake of conscience

verses.original: δὲ ἀλλὰ τοῦ ἑτέρου τὴν λέγω οὐχὶ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ συνείδησιν γὰρ ἵνα‿ τί μου ἡ ἐλευθερία κρίνεται ὑπὸ ἄλλης συνειδήσεως
verses.transliteration: de alla tou heterou tēn legō ouchi tēn heautou syneidēsin gar hina ti mou hē eleutheria krinetai hypo allēs syneidēseōs
verses.literal: - - the other [one’s] [ conscience ] I mean not - your own - For why . . . {should} my - freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience

verses.original: εἰ ἐγὼ μετέχω χάριτι τί βλασφημοῦμαι ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εὐχαριστῶ
verses.transliteration: ei egō metechō chariti ti blasphēmoumai hyper hou egō eucharistō
verses.literal: If I partake [in the meal] with thankfulness why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks

verses.original: οὖν Εἴτε ἐσθίετε εἴτε πίνετε εἴτε τι ποιεῖτε ποιεῖτε πάντα εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun Eite esthiete eite pinete eite ti poieite poieite panta eis doxan Theou
verses.literal: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do do it all to the glory of God

verses.original: γίνεσθε ἀπρόσκοποι καὶ Ἰουδαίοις καὶ Ἕλλησιν καὶ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ginesthe aproskopoi kai Ioudaiois kai Hellēsin kai tē ekklēsia tou Theou
verses.literal: Do not become a stumbling block . . . whether to Jews [or] Greeks [or] the church - of God

verses.original: καθὼς κἀγὼ ἀρέσκω πάντα πᾶσιν μὴ ζητῶν τὸ ἐμαυτοῦ σύμφορον ἀλλὰ τὸ τῶν πολλῶν ἵνα σωθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: kathōs kagō areskō panta pasin mē zētōn to emautou symphoron alla to tōn pollōn hina sōthōsin
verses.literal: as I also [try to] please everyone in all [I do] vvv [For] I am not seeking - my [own] good but [the good] - of many that they may be saved
